(the "Company") was incorporated in Nevada on April 6, 1998.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The Company was formed to seek opportunities to invest in real estate projects in Asia.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The Company has a 100% owned subsidiary, Asia Properties, International (Thailand) Ltd., which was registered in Thailand on August 2, 1999, to conduct the Company's real estate operations in Thailand.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>

<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 17.1pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: decimal 5.2in 461.7pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 17.1pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: decimal 5.2in 461.7pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">These consolidated financial statements have been prepared on the basis of a going concern which contemplates the realization of assets and the satisfaction of liabilities in the normal course of business.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The continued operations of the Company and the recoverability of the carrying value of assets is dependent upon the ability of the Company to obtain necessary financing to fund future operations and ultimately to attain profitable operations.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>To September 30, 2005, the Company has a working capital deficiency of $167,223 and has incurred losses since inception totaling $2,167,098.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Management's plans include obtaining additional capital through debt and equity financings.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 17.1pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: decimal 5.2in 461.7pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 17.1pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: decimal 5.2in 461.7pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Company will depend almost exclusively on outside capital to complete planned land acquisition and destination resort development.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Such capital would include the sale of additional capital stock and could include commercial borrowing.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>There can be no assurance that capital will be available as necessary to fund these development plans or, if the capital is available, that it will be on terms acceptable to the Company.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The issuance of additional equity securities by the Company may result in a significant dilution in the equity interests of current stockholders.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Obtaining commercial loans, assuming those loans would be available, will increase the Company's liabilities and future cash commitments.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>If the Company is unable to obtaining financing in the amounts and on terms deemed acceptable, future operations may be adversely affected.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 17.1pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: decimal 5.2in 461.7pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 17.1pt; TEXT-INDENT: -0.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: decimal 5.2in 461.7pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Given the Company's limited operating history, lack of sales, and its operating losses, there can be no assurance that it will be able to achieve objectives or reach profitability.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Accordingly, these factors raise substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 17.1pt; TEXT-INDENT: -0.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: decimal 5.2in 461.7pt"><br>

<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The preparation of financial statements in conformity with United States generally accepted accounting principles requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities and disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial statements and the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the reporting period.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Actual results could differ from those estimates. </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>

<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The financial statements are presented in United States dollars.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>In accordance with Statement of Financial Accounting Standards ("SFAS") No. 52, "Foreign Currency Translation", foreign denominated monetary assets and liabilities are translated to their United States dollar equivalents using foreign exchange rates, which prevailed at the balance sheet date.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Revenue and expenses are translated at average rates of exchange during the year.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Gains or losses resulting from foreign currency transactions are included in the results of operations.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.25in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>e)<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>Investment in shares</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Company considers the investment in shares of Entellium as available for sale securities.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>This investment is carried at cost as the fair market value is not readily determinable and the Company does not exercise significant influence over Entellium.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>In determining the appropriate fair value of this investment management considers whether there are there any factors to indicate that impairment in value has occurred.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Management believes that no adjustment for impairment in value is considered necessary at this time. </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>

<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>f)<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>Fair value of financial instruments</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.7in; tab-stops: .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In accordance with the requirements of SFAS No.107, management has determined the estimated fair value of financial instruments using available market information and appropriate valuation methodologies.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The fair value of financial instruments classified as current assets or liabilities including cash, accounts payable and accrued liabilities approximate carrying value due to the short-term maturity of the instruments.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.25in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .5in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The fair value of amounts due to related parties is not determinable as there are no specific terms of repayment.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;<br>
						<br>
					</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>

<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><B style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">2.<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES - Cont'd</FONT></B></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .2in .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .2in .5in .7in .9in">__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________<br>
</p>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.55in; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; tab-stops: .3in list .55in; mso-list: l45 level1 lfo61; mso-list-change: '%1:7:4:)' 'Daniel Mckinney' 20060206T2246"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">g)<FONT style="FONT: 7pt 'Times New Roman'">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT></FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Basic and Diluted Net Income (Loss) per Share </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Company computes net income (loss) per share in accordance with SFAS 128, "Earnings per Share".<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>SFAS 128 requires presentation of both basic and diluted earnings per share (EPS) on the face of the statement of operations.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Basic EPS is computed by dividing net income (loss) available to common shareholders (numerator) by the weighted average number of common shares outstanding (denominator) during the period.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Diluted EPS gives effect to all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period including stock options, using the treasury stock method, and convertible preferred stock, using the if-converted method.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>In computing diluted EPS, the average stock price for the period is used in determining the number of shares assumed to be purchased from the exercise of stock options or warrants.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Diluted EPS excludes all dilutive potential common shares if their effect is anti-dilutive.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>h)<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>Accounting for Stock-Based Compensation</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.2in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoCommentText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In December 2002, the Financial Accounting Standards Board issued Financial Accounting Standard No.148, "Accounting for Stock-Based Compensation - Transition and Disclosure" ("SFAS No. 148"), an amendment of Financial Accounting Standard No.&nbsp;123 "Accounting for Stock-Based Compensation" ("SFAS No. 123").<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The purpose of SFAS No. 148 is to: (1) provide alternative methods of transition for an entity that voluntarily changes to the fair value based method of accounting for stock-based employee compensation, (2) amend the disclosure provisions to require prominent disclosure about the effects on reported net income of an entity's accounting policy decisions with respect to stock-based employee compensation, and (3) to require disclosure of those effects in interim financial information.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The disclosure provisions of SFAS No. 148 were effective for the Company commencing December 31, 2002.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoCommentText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoCommentText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Company has elected to continue to account for stock-based employee compensation arrangements in accordance with the provisions of Accounting Principles Board Opinion No. 25, "Accounting for Stock Issued to Employees", ("APB No. 25") and comply with the disclosure provisions of SFAS No. 123 as amended by SFAS No. 148 as described above.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>In addition, in accordance with SFAS No. 123 the Company applies the fair value method using the Black-Scholes option-pricing model in accounting for options granted to consultants.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Under APB No. 25, compensation expense is recognized based on the difference, if any, on the date of grant between the estimated fair value of the Company's stock and the amount an employee must pay to acquire the stock.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Compensation expense is recognized immediately for past services and pro-rata for future services over the option-vesting period.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoCommentText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In accordance with SFAS No. 123, the Company applies the fair value method using the Black-Scholes option-pricing model in accounting for options granted to consultants.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoCommentText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoCommentText style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Company accounts for equity instruments issued in exchange for the receipt of goods or services from other than employees in accordance with SFAS No. 123 and the conclusions reached by the Emerging Issues Task Force ("EITF") in Issue No. 96-18, "Accounting for Equity Instruments That Are Issued to Other Than Employees for Acquiring or in Conjunction with Selling Goods or Services" ("EITF 96-18").<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Costs are measured at the estimated fair market value of the consideration received or the estimated fair value of the equity instruments issued, whichever is more reliably measurable.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The value of equity instruments issued for consideration other than employee services is determined on the earlier of a performance commitment or completion of performance by the provider of goods or services as defined by EITF 96-18.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: 17.1pt .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;<br>
						<br>
					</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: 17.1pt .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>

<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: center; tab-stops: -1.0in -.5in 284.8pt" align=center><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">September 30, 2005</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: center; tab-stops: -1.0in -.5in 284.8pt" align=center><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .2in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .2in .5in .7in .9in">__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________<br>
	<font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><u><font lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><font style="mso-tab-count: 2"><br>
							</font></font></u></font></font></font></font></p>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><B style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">2.<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES - Cont'd</FONT></B></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .2in .3in .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<p class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .2in .5in .7in .9in">__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________<br>
</p>
<P class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; tab-stops: .3in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 25.65pt; TEXT-INDENT: -25.65pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: 34.2pt .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">i)<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp; </FONT>Income Taxes </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt"></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 34.2pt; TEXT-INDENT: -34.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>The Company follows the liability method of accounting for income taxes.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Under this method, deferred income tax assets and liabilities are recognized for the estimated tax consequences attributable to differences between the financial statement carrying values and their respective income tax basis (temporary differences).<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The effect on deferred income tax assets and liabilities of a change in tax rates is recognized in income in the period that includes the enactment date.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>At September 30, 2005 a full deferred tax asset valuation allowance has been provided and no deferred tax asset benefit has been recorded.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; tab-stops: -1.0in -.5in .2in 284.8pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 25.65pt; TEXT-INDENT: -25.65pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: 34.2pt .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>j)<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>Impairment of long-lived assets</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in; TEXT-INDENT: -0.5in; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .7in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 34.2pt; TEXT-INDENT: -34.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 2">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>Certain long-term assets of the Company are reviewed at least quarterly to determine whether there are indications the carrying value has become impaired, pursuant to guidance established in Statement of Financial Accounting Standards ["SFAS"] No. 144, "Accounting for the Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets."<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Management considers assets to be impaired if the carrying value exceeds the future projected cash flows from related operations (undiscounted and without interest charges).<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>If impairment is deemed to exist, the assets will be written down to fair value.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Management also re-evaluates the periods of amortization to determine whether subsequent events and changes in circumstances warrant revised estimates of useful lives. </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 34.2pt; TEXT-INDENT: -34.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 25.65pt; TEXT-INDENT: -25.65pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: 34.2pt .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>k) Recent accounting pronouncements</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 34.2pt; TEXT-INDENT: -34.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 34.2pt; TEXT-INDENT: -34.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>In December 2004, the FASB issued Statement of Financial Accounting Standards ("SFAS") No. 123R, Share-Based Payment, which establishes standards for the accounting for transactions in which an entity exchanges its equity instruments for goods or services.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>A key provision of this statement is the requirement of a public entity to measure the cost of employee services received in exchange for an award of equity instruments (including stock options) based on the grant date fair value of the award.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>That cost will be recognized over the period during which an employee is required to provide service in exchange for the award (i.e., the requisite service period or vesting period).<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>This standard becomes effective for the Company for the interim period beginning after December 15, 2005.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Management is currently evaluating the impact of this standard on the Company's financial condition and results of operations.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 34.2pt; TEXT-INDENT: -34.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 34.2pt; TEXT-INDENT: -34.2pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; tab-stops: .5in .9in"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT lang=EN-GB style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB"><FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT>In December 2004, the FASB issued SFAS No. 153, <I style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal">Exchanges of Non-monetary Assets, an amendment of APB Opinion No. 29, Accounting for Non-monetary Transactions</I> ("SFAS 153").<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>SFAS 153 requires that exchanges of non-monetary, similar productive assets, and adds an exemption for non-monetary exchanges that do not have commercial substance.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>SFAS 153 will be effective for fiscal periods beginning after June 15, 2005.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Management does not believe that the adoption of this standard will have a material impact on the Company's financial condition or results of operations.</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: center; tab-stops: .3in 34.2pt .7in .9in" align=center><br>

Management's Discussion and Analysis or Plan Of Operation.</FONT></B></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><B style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal"><FONT style="COLOR: red">&nbsp;</FONT></B></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="COLOR: black">THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION SHOULD BE READ IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OF ASIA PROPERTIES AND THE NOTES THERETO APPEARING ELSEWHERE IN THIS FILING.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>STATEMENTS IN THIS MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OR PLAN OF OPERATION AND ELSEWHERE IN THIS REGISTRATION STATEMENT THAT ARE NOT STATEMENTS OF HISTORICAL OR CURRENT FACT CONSTITUTE "FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS."</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><FONT style="COLOR: black">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT></P>
<p style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc37063979"><font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc32196417"><font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc31779066"><font style="mso-bookmark: _Toc15823008"><u><font size=3>General Overview</font></u></font></font></font></font></p>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; mso-pagination: none; mso-layout-grid-align: none">Asia Properties, Inc. is a development stage company, which was incorporated in 1998.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Asia Properties currently invests in and develops real estate in Southeast Asia.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Asia Properties will initially devote most of its efforts toward organization and fund raising for planned Asian and Southeast Asian real estate investments, and from October 8, 2005 to December 22, 2005, approximately <FONT style="mso-bookmark: OLE_LINK23"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: OLE_LINK22"><FONT style="mso-bookmark: OLE_LINK21"><FONT style="COLOR: black">$</FONT></FONT></FONT></FONT><FONT style="COLOR: black">338,461 </FONT>in revenues have been generated from such operations.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Asia Properties has experienced recurring losses from operations since its inception and as of September 30, 2005, Asia Properties has had a working capital deficit of $167,223 and, since inception, an accumulated deficit from operations of $2,167,098. As noted in the independent audit report for the audited Asia Properties financial statements for the year ending 2004, these factors raise doubt about the ability of Asia Properties to continue as a going concern.<FONT style="COLOR: maroon"><FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT></FONT><FONT lang=EN-GB style="mso-ansi-language: EN-GB">Realization of the Company's business plan is dependent upon the Company's ability to meet its future financing requirements, and the success of future operations.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT></FONT>Although we have generated some revenues, our only other source for cash is through investments or loans from management.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>We must raise additional cash to fully implement our projects and stay in business.</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><br>
</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><U>Form F-4 Registration Statement Filing and Withdrawal.</U></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><B style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</B></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">On April 25, 2000, Asia Properties, Inc. filed a Form F-4 Registration Statement (Commission File No. 333-11892) as the registrant, Asia Properties Investments, Inc., in order to properly affect the reincorporation of Asia Properties from the State of Nevada to the British Virgin Islands.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>On June 19, 2002, the Form F-4 Registration Statement was withdrawn via a Form RW following the decision by the Company not to proceed with the reincorporation from a Nevada corporation to a British Virgin Islands company.</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="COLOR: black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="COLOR: black">Previously, The efforts to purchase a Thailand real estate company, Northbridge Communities Limited, was terminated on November 20, 2000 and removed from the F-4.</FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">The Company has decided not to reincorporate elsewhere and will remain as a Nevada corporation.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Asia Properties Investments Inc. was incorporated solely for the purpose of redomiciling in the British Virgin Islands and the proposed merger.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>As the merger did not proceed, Asia Properties Investments, Inc has been terminated.</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;</P>

On July 26, 2004, the <U>Form SB-2</U> Registration Statement was withdrawn via a Form RW following the decision by the Company not to proceed with the registration because we had terminated an agreement<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>with<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Cornell Capital Partners which formed the primary securities that were to be registered by the Form SB-2. No securities were offered or sold pursuant to this registration<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>statement. <br>

<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><U>Loans by Management</U></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 14.45pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; mso-pagination: none; mso-layout-grid-align: none; mso-line-height-rule: exactly">In July 2000, Asia Properties received loans from Daniel S. McKinney and Nicholas St. Johnston, executive officers and directors of Asia Properties, and their affiliated entities in the total amount of approximately $411,348.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Specifically, these loans were as follows: Daniel Mckinney - $92,580, Coldway Limited - $139,000 (Mr. McKinney and his spouse, Ms. Gaik-Im own 100% of the outstanding shares of Coldway Limited) Nicholas St. Johnston $40,768. Milliard Limited $139,000 (Nicholas St. Johnston owns 100% of the outstanding shares of Milliard Limited).<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>These loans were unsecured, were not interest bearing and no other charges were to be applied.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>The loans were payable on demand.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Additionally, <FONT style="mso-bookmark: OLE_LINK5">Daniel McKinney, loaned $42,337 to API in 2001, $58,908 in 2002, $14,373 in 2003 and $35,086.00 from January 1, 2004 to June 30, 2004 for general expenses and operatio</FONT>ns. </P>
<P class=MsoIndex1 style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 14.45pt; mso-pagination: none; mso-layout-grid-align: none; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 14.45pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; mso-pagination: none; mso-layout-grid-align: none; mso-line-height-rule: exactly">Asia Properties was unable to repay the loans in cash and therefore issued shares of common stock in repayment of the loans.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>This shareholder loan was converted to additional shares of 411,348 on December 29, 2000 at a price of $1.00 per share.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Daniel McKinney, a director loaned $42,337 to API in 2001, $58,908 in 2002, $14,373 in 2003 and $35,086.00 from January 1, 2004 to June 30, 2004 for general expenses and operations.</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 14.45pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; mso-pagination: none; mso-layout-grid-align: none; mso-line-height-rule: exactly">&nbsp;</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 14.45pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; mso-pagination: none; mso-layout-grid-align: none; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><U>Entellium Corporation</U></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 14.45pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; mso-pagination: none; mso-layout-grid-align: none; mso-line-height-rule: exactly">&nbsp;</P>

Entellium is an Application Service Provider (ASP), with offices in USA, Malaysia and Singapore, which provides Customer Relations Management ("CRM") solutions based on the Microsoft.NET(R) web services platform. Entellium Corporation is a State of Delaware corporation and is not publicly traded.</P>

<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal">Plan of Operations</B></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><B style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</B></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">During the three months ended September 30, 2005, the Company acquired a total of 57 land plots of the <FONT style="mso-bookmark: OLE_LINK3">Baan Naiyang Resort in Phuket Thailand</FONT>, for the purpose of developing the land and building resort properties for resale. The Company issued 995,000 shares of common stock with an estimated fair market value of $1,360,000 to purchase the properties. Expenses of $42,553 have been incurred to develop the land and begin construction on the property.</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="COLOR: black">When possible through financings or through negotiations on purchases, we intend to use our common stock to finance acquisitions and retain as much cash as possible for working capital and development purposes.</FONT></P>

<p style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><u><font size=3>Foreign currency</font></u></p>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">Asia Properties prepares its financial statements using United States dollars as the reporting currency.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>However, some transactions are conducted in Thailand currency - Baht, which is the functional currency in Thailand.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Transactions in Baht are translated into United States dollars as the financial reporting currency.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Foreign currency transactions are translated at the applicable rates of exchange prevailing at the dates of the transactions.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Assets and liabilities are denominated at applicable rates prevailing at the balance sheet date.</P>

<p style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><u><font size=3>Inflation</font></u></p>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">Asia Properties acquires and develops real estate projects in Southeast Asia.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Real estate values are inflation sensitive and fluctuate from time to time, depending on factors such as the general economic conditions in Southeast Asia. </P>

<p style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><u><font size=3>New Accounting Standards</font></u></p>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">Statement of Financial Accounting Standards No. 133, Accounting for Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities, was issued in June 1998 and will be effective for all fiscal quarters for all fiscal years, which began after June 15, 2000.<FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>This standard established accounting and reporting standards for derivative financial instruments and for hedging activities. </P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"></P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">&nbsp;<br>
</P>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp;</FONT><B style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal">Item 3.<FONT style="mso-tab-count: 1">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="mso-spacerun: yes">&nbsp; </FONT>Controls and Procedures.</B></P>

<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Our President (the &quot;Certifying Officer&quot;) is responsible for establishing and maintaining disclosure controls and procedures for Asia Properties.&nbsp; He has concluded, based upon his evaluation of these controls and procedures as of a date within 90&nbsp;days of filing of this report, that our disclosure controls and procedures are effective to ensure that information required to be disclosed by us in this report is accumulated and communicated to our management, including the Certifying Officer as appropriate, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure.&nbsp; The Certifying Officer also has indicated that there were no significant changes in our internal controls or other factors that could significantly affect such controls subsequent to the date of their evaluation, and there were no corrective actions with regard to significant deficiencies or material weakness.</p>
<P class=MsoNormal style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><br>
